texto.muro: the calm, deep dark studio space on the left 45% of the frame

escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, epic scale, a vast dark studio at night): she stands on the RIGHT side of the frame, framed from the waist up, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. Her head is almost frontal: both eyes, both eyebrows and both cheeks visible, only her eyes turn. She looks straight into the lens with calm confidence, her right hand slightly raised at waist height, fingertips glowing. Far behind her, standing vertically in the darkness, rises ONE colossal ring of sky-blue light (#2FB8FF) like a portal, seen slightly from the side, with ONE small blazing white sphere at its top; hundreds of fine luminous sky-blue threads flow out of the depth through the ring and gather toward her raised fingertips. The ring is the brightest element; its light rims her hair, shoulder and jacket from behind and lights one side of her face. Cool rim light from behind separates her from the background. Thin haze catches every light. The LEFT 45% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no light, no particles, no objects. The whole frame is cool and contemporary: nothing warm, amber, orange or golden. No robots, no mascots, no cartoon characters, no cloud symbols, no logos of any other brand, no readable text, no screens.
